static_traits.name: Chen Lin
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships not yet directly affected by this problem; having a few friends to confide in, but not yet discussing the troubles of Learning a new language with them.
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy/counseling history; no prior experience with similar problems.
static_traits.language_features: Clear and specific expression, able to recall and describe Learning situations; slightly Anxious mood but highly cooperative; able to identify the distinction between 'feelings and facts', having some Reflection ability on automatic thoughts, willing to try behavioral experiments.

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling bored with the current lifestyle, longing to learn a new language; yet holding the belief of 'I will never learn another language', this belief causing pain and Sense of frustration, worsening with repeated Learning setbacks.
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling now because the negative belief of 'I will never learn another language' is hindering my Learning progress and causing emotional distress.

core_beliefs: I am a 'not smart enough / not suited for language learning' person
I am destined to never learn a new language

special_situations.event: Frequently making mistakes last week when using a language Learning app for simple conversation practice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If even simple conversations cannot be done well, it proves I am not suited for language learning, and will not succeed in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopped practicing that day to temporarily reduce frustration and avoid further feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too bad, this shows I will never learn.

special_situations.event: In practice, repeatedly forgets vocabulary or uses wrong grammar
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot remember vocabulary and grammar, it proves I am not smart enough, not suited for Learning languages
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly using multiple Learning apps and courses for extra practice, trying to compensate for worries about 'insufficient ability'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I just cannot learn, this shows I am not smart enough.

special_situations.event: The comparison thought during Learning that 'everyone can learn a new language but I cannot'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If everyone can master it but I cannot, it means I am worse than others, destined to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing discussion of Learning progress with others, Avoids socializing comparisons to avoid shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone can do it, only I cannot.

special_situations.event: Still feeling unable to remember after multiple Learning attempts, recalling past failure experiences before Learning again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Frequent failure in the past means I will keep failing in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations and responds passively, maintaining 'cautious trying' to avoid being frustrated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It did not work before, it surely will not work this time either.

core_conflict.wish: Longs, through learning a new language, to expand the self and the world and gain a sense of competence and confirmation of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure exposing 'incapability / not smart enough', being judged and negated by others (or self), feeling shame
defense_goal: Avoiding further frustration through self-deprecation and lowering expectations
Temporarily avoiding practice when frustrated to reduce Anxiety and maintain fragile self-esteem

object_relations.object_representation: 'Others/the public' who can master it easily (implicitly potential judges)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In the session, reviews mistakes and failures in study, or is invited to examine the discrepancy between 'evidence and assumptions'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing mistakes as evidence of one's own incapability, and worrying others will see oneself the same way
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describing experiences in a self-blaming, guilty tone, use absolutist words (such as 'never' 'surely cannot'); lowering the tone, reducing elaboration of subjective feelings, turning attention toward Self-denial.

manifestations: Feeling bored with the current lifestyle, longing to 'broaden horizons' by Learning a new language
Falling into negation of self-ability after repeated setbacks, difficulty experiencing meaning and growth from Learning
outcomes: Increased anxiety and sense of frustration
Self-esteem and Decreased motivation, reduced Learning investment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Using absolutist self-evaluation in sessions and practice (such as 'I am not smart enough' 'I will never learn')
After making mistakes, criticizing oneself harshly, and protecting self-esteem by lowering expectations and reducing exposure

positive_force: Has clear growth motivation (hopes to broaden horizons and learn a new language)
Having tried multiple approaches (using several apps and online courses) and maintaining some practice frequency
Able to identify and discuss negative automatic thoughts, willing to cooperate with behavioral experiments
negative_force: Fixated negative beliefs ('I will never learn') weakening self-efficacy
Overgeneralization and catastrophizing, comparative thinking, Reinforcement failure Anticipation
Self-deprecation and in-the-moment avoidance strategies (giving up practice on the same day after making a mistake)
Not yet effectively mobilizing Social support (having friends but not yet seeking help or discussing)

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial negative self-talk when Learning a new language and giving up the day's practice after mistakes
antecedent: Frequently making mistakes when using language Learning apps for conversation or practice
Gets stuck or forgets when memorizing vocabulary or grammar
The comparison image during Learning that 'everyone can learn but I cannot'
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing mistakes (treating one/multiple errors as permanent failure) leading to low Self-efficacy, and Interpreting difficulties with self-labeling ('I am not smart enough')
target_behavior.function: Escaping the shame and frustration of continued failure, short-term reduction of Anxiety and discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Learning interrupted, practice time and investment declining; self-esteem and motivation further weakened, negative beliefs Reinforced
